app.name: Rebuffer
card.current: This is what the clipboard holds right now
empty.allBody: Copy anything - text, images, files - and it lands here.
empty.imagesBody: Screenshots and pictures you copy will show up here.
empty.textBody: Text you copy appears here, searchable in an instant.
empty.linksBody: Copied URLs collect in this tab.
empty.filesBody: Files copied from Explorer appear here.
empty.referencesBody: Use + Add to keep a file here by reference - it is never copied and never expires.
empty.pinnedBody: Pin an item to keep it safe from cleanup.
settings.hotkeyRecording: Press the combination now — Esc cancels.
settings.aggressiveModeHint: The hook swallows the chord before Windows sees it (needed for chords the system owns, like Win+V). Some antivirus products flag low-level keyboard hooks; the hook only compares a combination and posts a message — it never logs.
settings.winVHint: Turns Windows' own clipboard history on or off — the panel Win+V opens. It applies to the current Windows user only, not other accounts. While it is off, Win+V no longer opens Windows' clipboard history. Rebuffer's own clipboard capture is separate and keeps working either way. Turning it on writes an explicit “on” value, the same way the Windows Settings app does.
settings.capturePaused: Capturing is paused; history and the hotkey still work.
settings.autoPasteHint: Sends Ctrl+V into the app you were using. If that app runs elevated, Windows blocks the keystroke — the clipboard write still succeeds, so paste manually.
settings.pastePlain: Paste as plain text by default
settings.storeLocationHint: Moving copies the database and every blob, verifies the copy, then deletes the old tree. A cancel rolls back.
settings.tempFilesHint: An item that exists only as clipboard data has no file until you open it, reveal it or drag it out. One is written for you then, and this is how long it stays before it is cleaned up.
settings.maxItemSizeHint: Copies above this size are discarded before anything is written.
settings.notifyFull: Notify when the store nears its cap
settings.cleanOlder: Clean items older than this many days now
settings.themeHint: Applies to both windows immediately. Each theme brings its own accent.
settings.dragBarHint: Adds an empty strip along the top of the popup. Hold the left mouse button on it to move the window. The window grows by the strip's height, so the list keeps the size you set above. The popup still opens at the cursor every time, so a window you moved comes back to the pointer on the next hotkey.
settings.showAge: Show the time badge on cards
settings.timeFormatHint: The clock time an item was copied at. Its date is in the group heading above it.
settings.respectFlags: Respect apps’ “exclude from clipboard history” flags
settings.respectFlagsHint: Apps like password managers mark their copies so history tools skip them. Without this, the store becomes a plaintext password log.
settings.linkPreviews: Look up what a copied link points at
settings.linkPreviewsHint: A copied YouTube link gets the video's real name and its thumbnail instead of a bare youtube.com. The lookup happens once, when the link is captured, and the result is stored, so opening the window later contacts nobody. Switching this on also looks up the YouTube links already in your history. Nothing else is looked up: only youtube.com, youtu.be and youtube-nocookie.com are ever contacted, and only with the link itself.
settings.blockedHint: Copies made while one of these processes is in the foreground are ignored.
settings.exportHint: Writes a .rbx archive containing your settings, every item, and all blobs. It holds your full clipboard history in the clear — keep it somewhere safe.
settings.clearHistoryHint: Removes every captured item except pinned ones and manual shelf references. This cannot be undone.
settings.resetAllHint: Removes everything, including pinned items and manual shelf references. This cannot be undone.
settings.aboutBody: A fast, persistent clipboard history for Windows. Everything you copy stays for 30 days and comes back with one hotkey.
hotkey.winX: Win+X opens the Quick Link menu
hotkey.errInvalidKey: That key cannot be used as a hotkey. Use a letter, digit, or F1–F24.
hotkey.warnBareKey: A bare-key hotkey fires while you type — hold a modifier.
hotkey.warnSystemCopy: This intercepts the system copy/cut/paste shortcut.
hotkey.warnWinChord: Windows owns most Win+key chords; if registration fails, use Aggressive mode.
hotkey.reservedChord: {name} — Windows owns that chord and RegisterHotKey will refuse it. Switch on Aggressive mode to claim it anyway.
